children: Addus HomeCare entered into an Equity and Asset Purchase Agreement to acquire AccentCare’s personal care and community care business outside New York for $275 million in cash, subject to customary adjustments. The transaction includes equity interests in multiple subsidiaries across Georgia, Tennessee, Texas, Arizona, Illinois, California, Washington, Minnesota, and Pennsylvania, plus certain Colorado assets and liabilities. Closing is subject to customary conditions, including regulatory approvals and HSR clearance; there is no financing condition and no termination or reverse termination fee.
